nodes.label: Road to Paid Public Launch (tracker)
nodes.rationale: Phases 1-2 are mandatory for a real deploy, Phase 3 is compliance, Phase 4 is post-launch differentiation.

nodes.label: Design Re-Shaped: 4-Slide Homepage Plan
nodes.rationale: Sales principles per slide: benefit-led headline (not 'we do X'), name the pain (commission, scams, paperwork, time), handle the objection (QES + verified + encrypted), show proof (real listings + live counts), one unambiguous CTA.

nodes.label: AES 'Bank-Model' Signing Ceremony
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Advanced Electronic Signature ceremony reusing existing KYC + OTP (sole-control factor) + contractDocumentHash (tamper-evidence) + Signature audit trail, embedded in the PDF (PAdES). Removes the ~EUR 80/yr personal-cert barrier; legally sufficient for rentals and antecontracts. Hybrid plan: AES default, uploaded-cert QES for power users, on-demand QTSP QES later as premium. Needs legal posture confirmed first.

nodes.label: QES Provider Decision
nodes.rationale: Keep uploaded-cert verification (src/lib/qesVerify.ts) vs integrate a QTSP (certSIGN/Namirial/DocuSign EU Qualified) for on-demand QES.

nodes.label: Landlord Payouts (Stripe Connect / escrow)
nodes.rationale: Scaffolded (PAYOUTS_ENABLED gated on STRIPE_CONNECT_ENABLED, pure ownerNetFromRent, createOwnerPayout seam). Launch-critical and regulatory: the Connect / payment-facilitator decision and handling of third-party funds (payment-institution rules) must be resolved with legal before enabling real transfers.

nodes.label: Contract PDF Generation (pdf-lib)
nodes.rationale: On-demand, deterministic generation (unsigned preview + signed final) from ContractDocument, with a QES audit block (signer, provider, timestamp, ref + SHA-256 doc hash). Embeds Noto Sans for Romanian diacritics; outputFileTracingIncludes ships the fonts in the serverless bundle. Persisting a frozen signed artifact deferred: regeneration is deterministic, so functionally equivalent.

nodes.label: Persistent Object Storage (S3/R2) Seam
nodes.rationale: storageBackend.ts behind the storage.ts seam: local FS default, S3/R2 when STORAGE_DRIVER=s3 with the SDK lazy-loaded; env.ts warns when storage is not persistent. KYC docs remain write-only (only the content hash is consumed), so presigned short-TTL reads are still TODO.

nodes.label: Hash-Chained Immutable Audit Log
nodes.rationale: AuditLog rows chained via advisory-lock-serialized seq/prevHash for tamper evidence; wired into signing, activation, settlement, terms changes, termination/renewal/cancel/deposit; trail shown on the contract page.

nodes.label: Dunning (Late / Missed Payment Handling)
nodes.rationale: processDunning runs in the daily cron: upcoming-due reminders plus escalating overdue notices, idempotent via Payment.lastReminderAt. Penalty/late-fee auto-charge deferred because it needs a contractual clause basis.

nodes.label: Listing Fraud Detection (Perceptual Hashing)
nodes.rationale: aHash (8x8 grayscale -> 64-bit) with a Hamming-distance threshold flags stolen photos across owners (PhotoSignature recorded on upload), plus near-identical text listings; runs best-effort on photo upload, files a deduplicated system report and notifies admins. LSH/bucketing noted for scale.

nodes.label: Arvuna (AVANS) Forfeit Rules
nodes.rationale: cancelSaleContract: buyer backs out -> forfeits arvuna; seller backs out -> owes double per Civil Code art. 1544; admin/no-arvuna -> simple cancel.

nodes.label: Rental Deposit (Garantie) Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: returnRentalDeposit: held -> returned/partial/forfeited at contract end with damage deductions; records REFUND (tenant) + DAUNE (owner); idempotent via depositStatus.

nodes.label: Cookie-Based i18n (RO/EN)
nodes.rationale: Cookie-based locale instead of a [locale] route segment, with a typed dictionary system; ro/en key parity enforced at compile time (en: Dictionary) and by test.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Display (RON/EUR)
nodes.rationale: Amounts stay stored in RON as the payment source of truth; EUR is a display representation derived from the BNR reference rate (cached ~6h) with EUR_RON_RATE override and static fallback.

nodes.label: Admin Support Tooling
nodes.rationale: Manual KYC override, listing moderation, idempotent payment refund, audit-chain verification - all audited. Impersonation deliberately implemented as a read-only support view rather than act-as, because acting as a user is a security footgun.
